finalReading.passage: When Grandpa first heard about AI doctors, he laughed and said that no machine could ever care for a patient. A year later, a smart program spotted his heart problem early, and the real doctors used its warning to treat him in time. Now Grandpa says that the cleverest care appears when people and machines work side by side.

questions.q: How did Grandpa feel about AI doctors at first?
options: He doubted that a machine could care for patients.
He trusted them completely at once.
He decided to build one himself.
He had never heard of them before.
